title: Prepared Nf Authentication
objective: Authenticate the prepared-NF allowlist against the supplied cubic polynomial, basis, multiplication tensor, discriminant, signature, and embeddings without class/unit answers

oracles: Exact cubic quotient-ring arithmetic plus independent high-precision embedding residuals

handoff.summary: Added an exact host preflight for the H1 prepared number field and made the Outcome-C sanitizer fail closed on it. The preflight proves cubic irreducibility, discriminant/signature/index, basis inverse and all multiplication structure constants, validates packed and rounded real embeddings as approximate algebra homomorphisms, reconstructs runtime prime/product tables, and returns a live authority digest. Both unified-root checkers now authenticate their prepared inputs. Fifteen focused corruptions are rejected.
risks: This is deliberately the fixed cubic H1 runtime policy (degree 3, p192, prime limit 65537, factor limit 1048576), not yet a general nfinit authority API.
The embedding check assumes each packed PARI real has error at most one stored ulp; the bound is conservative and source-documented, but it is not an independently certified root enclosure.
The base integration contains an unrelated unclassified pari_h1_outcome_c_adapter.c, so architecture-policy unit tests fail before this lane's full suite can finish.
next_steps: Have the integration lane review and merge the authority call before any unified computation is described as Outcome C.
Classify the pre-existing PARI adapter C file, then rerun test:unit and merge:check.
If this boundary is generalized, replace fixed runtime-policy constants with a separately versioned and authenticated preparation policy.
